author: Intel
description:
The University of Alabama Athletics is solving this challenge with edge AI. Alabama deployed WaitTime’s crowd intelligence platform powered by Intel® Xeon® CPUs. By utilizing real-time computer vision on-site, stadium operators receive anonymous crowd flow data instantly. This allows them to monitor ticket gates and concessions, shift staff dynamically, change concession operations and reduce wait times. Processing data locally at the edge ensures that raw video files never leave the stadium. This architecture delivers high-performance computer vision results on Intel Xeon CPUs without the added overhead in cost, power, and complexity that comes with cloud computing. The result is an efficient, high-revenue venue operation and a better game-day experience for fans.
